note: Seven documents designing the 61 NFR ids D5 defines, plus 22 citations marked N/A. D5 creates no table, writes nothing and adds no money arithmetic, so the concurrency and migration designs of D1-D4 are inapplicable and are named individually rather than dropped silently. 11 Deferred rows, each naming an obligation whose verifier is review, a recorded decision or a human step - not unaddressed work wearing a label. Six of ten observability obligations are unautomated, which is high for this record and is the honest count: five are prohibitions, and a prohibition verifier is review unless a scanner exists. Zero GAP rows.
